answer: Cryptographic stake weighting acts as a rigid reef against autonomous agent Sybil swarms by enforcing a costly economic threshold. To harvest protocol rewards or vote on network state, each AI node must lock up scarce collateral, much like staking valuable timber or securing a high-stakes mountain ridge. An attacker attempting to flood the decentralized network with millions of fake agent identities faces linear capital exhaustion, as the financial cost of provisioning sufficient collateral makes mass fabrication economically non-viable.
